Actor and Songwriter Gerrit Graham Dies at 76

Gerrit Graham, known for his roles in "Phantom of the Paradise" and "Star Trek," and for co-writing songs with the Grateful Dead, has died at the age of 76. Fans remembered his performance as glam rocker Beef in "Phantom of the Paradise." The cause of his death was not specified in the coverage.
